closeSilent.toggle: Close tickets when the customer stays silent
closeSilent.help: When a ticket waits on the customer and our message is the last one, send the nudge below after some days, then close the ticket if they still do not reply. Each step goes through approvals like any other send, in the name of the routine Close silent tickets, never yours. Only tickets we write to after you switch this on count.
closeSilent.nudgeTextHelp: Leave it empty to send the default wording, in the customer's language.
closeSilent.defaultNudge:
Hello,

We have not heard back from you, so we are checking in: did our last message answer your question, or is there anything else we can help with?

If we do not hear from you within {{days}} days, we will close this ticket. You can still reply to this email at any time to reopen it.

Thank you

card.backlogHow: Counted by the server over every open ticket you can see, not over a page of results
